svg.title: Airflow execution_date, data_interval_start, data_interval_end across days
svg.desc: RFD 0007 — Gantt-style timeline showing how an @daily Airflow DAG's execution_date (logical_date), data_interval_start, and data_interval_end relate over four consecutive days. The data-ready event emitted after each run carries data_interval_start and data_interval_end, replacing the checkpoint tables in curation-libs and caspian-im-foundation.
svg.text: Each row is one scheduled DAG run. The event payload carries the interval window — replacing the checkpoint table.

g.text: data_interval_start → data_interval_end (the business window the run processes)
execution_date / logical_date — same instant as data_interval_start for @daily
DAG run actually starts at data_interval_end (interval is closed before scheduling)
data-ready event emitted after the run; payload carries data_interval_start and data_interval_end
Replaces the checkpoint table: the next consumer's high-water mark is the event's data_interval_end.
